comment: T0=2018-02-24 22:21:07.725300 UT is the precise Swift/BAT trigger (official BAT snapshot; GCN 22442 reports 22:21:07 UT to integer-second precision; trigger 811561); the previously stored 22:21:44 UT is the MASTER-Kislovodsk pointing time in GCN 22444, not the trigger. Afterglow position uses the UVOT position in GCN 22454: RA=202.68377 deg, Dec=+38.07902 deg, 90% error radius 0.46 arcsec. GCN 22447 gives BAT T90=10.9±3.6 s (15–350 keV; 90% errors); the Swift sample table in Becerra et al. 2023 Table 3 lists 10.92±3.57 s. The duration is >2 s, so sub_tag=lgrb follows the catalog T90 rule. No secure redshift is reported in the reviewed sources; GCN 22446 only suggests SDSS J133044.06+380443.0 as a possible host, so host_galaxy remains null. GCN 22444 MASTER used “GRB180224.93” and “GRB180224.94” as event labels; retained as sourced aliases. Sparse-photometry search (2026-11-02): local gcn/archive absent; external/rssgrbag 0 matches; external/grbsn_webtool 0 source matches; external/mpe_greiner has one event metadata row but no photometry; Swift catalogs provide trigger and UVOT summary only. Official GCN event archive has 9 circulars; 6 optical/UV follow-up circulars (22442, 22444, 22446, 22448, 22452, 22454) were inspected. Crossref query returned 100 results with no exact source-title/abstract hit; arXiv exact-phrase API returned 0; OpenAlex returned 12 records including 7 GCN notices/circulars. Web/publisher search found two relevant journal papers: Becerra et al. 2023 Table 3 (T90 only) and Ror et al. 2025 (UVOT/XRT model analysis, no per-exposure table); neither supplies new raw photometry rows. Added 11 source-anchored rows from GCN 22444, 22448, and 22454. The AbAO GCN 22448 detection uses the table-declared midpoint t−T0=0.15162 d (13100 s) per maintainer ruling. The circular’s absolute start plus continuous 60×60 s midpoint estimate is 1310.7253 s earlier; unreported frame gaps may explain it but are not confirmed. The GCN 22452 OASDG row uses its absolute start plus the reported 9×180 s sequence midpoint (the circular’s relative 1.21 h is approximate).

extra_data.t0_note: T0 is the precise Swift/BAT trigger 2018-02-24 22:21:07.725300 UT (trigger 811561; official BAT snapshot); GCN 22442 reports the same trigger to integer-second precision as 22:21:07 UT. The previous 22:21:44 UT was the MASTER-Kislovodsk pointing time (GCN 22444).
